meta_data.base_class: Send selected <physical items> as gifts to a designated address - refers to various tangible objects that can be mailed or delivered.

tool_template.name: send_<class>
tool_template.description: Sends a selected <class> to a specified address.

address.description: Address where the <class> should be sent.

selected_item_id.description: The selected <class> identifier to be sent.

gift_message.description: A personalized message to include with the <class>.

tracking_notification.description: Indicates if the sender wants to receive tracking updates for the <class>.

signature_required.description: Specifies if a signature is required upon delivery of the <class>.

fragile_handling.description: Indicates if the <class> requires special handling due to its fragile nature.
